# watch — recurring monitor jobs

Field names are the JSON body names; MCP clients see the same names in the
tool's `inputSchema`, so this file is a fallback for raw-HTTP calls and for
reading a `16002` message that names a field.

### `flowda_watch_create` · `POST /v1/watch/jobs`

Scope `watch` · `/v1` budget 30s · gateway pre-charge 1 credit.

| field | type | required | notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| country | string | no | Access region for the checks. |
| diff_modes | array<string> | no | `auto` cannot be combined with `text`/`json`; no duplicates. |
| headers | object<string, string> | no | Extra headers for the checks. |
| mask | object | no | Noise reduction applied before diffing. |
| mask.enabled | boolean | no | default `false` |
| mask.exclude | array<string> | no | — |
| retention_days | integer | no | Check-history retention; 0 keeps history indefinitely. · default `30` · range 0–365 |
| schedule | object | yes | Exactly one of `interval_seconds` (UTC, 60–2592000 seconds) or `cron` (five-field expression, interpreted in `timezone`). |
| schedule.cron | string | no | — |
| schedule.interval_seconds | integer | no | range 60–2592000 |
| selector | string | no | Monitor only part of the page. |
| selector_type | string | no | one of `css`, `xpath` · default `css` |
| timezone | string | no | IANA timezone name; affects `cron` schedules only. · default `UTC` |
| url | string | yes | Page to monitor; immutable afterwards. |
| webhook_url | string | no | Callback for change events; https, a public host and port 80/443 are required. Rewritten to flowda's relay before it reaches the platform. · nullable |

Body field names are identical for `application/json` and `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`.
